purpose: Held-out set for v5.10: does a request start new work that needs the product brief and story walk? new_work true = a new product, a new feature or overhaul, or a new kind of system. false = a fix, a small adjustment, maintenance or an operational task. Written and committed before any model saw it.
rule_under_test: Jev adds the brief line when depth.choice is FULL or CRITICAL with confidence >= 0.5, small_adjustment < 0.5 and code_only < 0.5. Jev may only add the line, never remove one the words give.
